newsitem.title: USA: U.S West Coast prods flat amid directionless NYMEX.
newsitem.headline: U.S West Coast prods flat amid directionless NYMEX.

text.p: U.S. West Coast wholesale product prices were notionally flat early Tuesday, amid a directionless NYMEX and faint activity as traders waited for the American Petroleum Institute (API) to release stock data.
While NYMEX February gasoline advanced on technical buying, heating oil contracts eased about 0.64 cents a gallon to 66.55 cents. Crude, which expires today, was down 35 cents.
CARB gasoline in Los Angeles was heard done at 78 cents a gallon yesterday, but no deals were stuck early Tuesday with offers notionally flat at 79 cents.
Conventional gasoline in L.A. was offered at 75 cents, unchanged.
Traders said gasoline volumes on the market would ease during the second cycle of February, as fewer winter blending components were added, dropping the volume of gasoline production.
